plugins.name: fetch-guard
plugins.description: MCP server for controlled web fetching with URL whitelist enforcement

plugins.name: skill-cache
plugins.description: Cache the output of any side-effect-free skill. On a hit, returns the cached file; on a miss, delegates to the named skill and caches the result.

plugins.name: decision-traces
plugins.description: Decision trace logger — MCP server with dynamic multi-schema support and configurable storage/embedding backends

plugins.name: db-query
plugins.description: Structured read-only database querying for AI agents — MCP server exposing allowlisted PostgreSQL and SQL Server tables/views through portable filter operators

plugins.name: sm-workflow
plugins.description: Drive agent workflows as explicit, resumable state machines. Ships the run-workflow driver skill for the `step` CLI.

plugins.name: sm-workflow-dev
plugins.description: Design, port, and modify SM workflows. Ships the design-workflow authoring skill for workflow.yaml and STATE.md, validated with the `step` CLI.
